reviews.text: MORE PRAISE FOR POOLWERX! Our spa went dead just before the recent run of very cold weather. We were about to leave town for several weeks and we were very concerned that our spa would be damaged from the severe cold. We reached out to POOLWERX CARROLLTON and they promptly scheduled a visit by their experienced technician. Adam. Within minutes the underlying problem was diagnosed: corrosion in the heater cabinet led to water leakage that shorted the electronics. Adam and his team were able to quickly acquire a replacement OEM- quality spa heater and completed the install the very next day. It was a cold morning and the available working space was very crowded, but Adam kept his sense of humor and focused on the task at hand. Shortly thereafter, we were able to restore power to the spa and began heating the fresh water. Adam then re inspected the entire system and declared everything was good-to-go. Bottom line: stop worrying about your spa and simply call POOLWERX CARROLLTON. Be sure to ask for Adam!

reviews.text:
I called Poolwerks Carrollton for a system inspection of a pool in my house that I had recently bought. They sent a tech the next day, who helped me with approximately 50% of the issues I was trying to figure out about the system. That ends the positives I have to report about this company.

Negatives:

1) Tech not very competent. I suspected that one of the valves was not functioning properly. Tech did not have the wherewithal to troubleshoot this, but rather decided to take my word for it and sell me a new valve. On a separate issue, I have an auto-fill that is not working. Tech could not figure it out.

2) *CHARGING: HUGE PROBLEM THERE.*

I was quoted approximately $150 for the service call (never in writing). Note: they need your credit card info in advance, before scheduling the call. In retrospect, that jibes with what followed.

The tech quoted me about $190 for the replacement of the valve. Based on this, I said yes.

A week later, I get a receipt for $555.66 charged to my credit card. This is not pieced out in any way: just one line.

Fortunately I remembered the two numbers quoted to me, and can add, and so I called them for an explanation. After meeting with the tech, the person on the phone said the number was miskeyed in their system, and issued a refund for $150. Then I was sent an itemized invoice that quotes labor at $200, the valve at $189.99, and $15.67 in tax.

This is still not what I was quoted. The number $200 was never mentioned to me in advance. I assumed that the changing of the valve would be included in the service call quoted, since that took the tech all of a minute to do. I have emailed them about this, and as of the writing of this review am waiting for a response.

Should anything change, I will update this review.

In the meantime, make up your mind if you want to do business with this company, based on:

1) Credit card information in advance.
2) No price quotes ever in writing.
3) Unitemized charges for randomly made up numbers that are hugely in their favor (we're talking on the order of 50%).

Even if these were genuine mistakes, how much do you want to have to scrutinize your pool company at every step?

reviews.text:
Man. Can I make this zero stars?  Let’s start at the price. If you can even get them to show up one of the 3 times they say they would. They start at $60. That is just for the person. But the $60 does not guarantee they actually show up (don’t get charged if they don’t show up). THAT 60 DOES NOT INCLUDE CHEMICALS. But you set up service, they get you by saying they will be out but never show up multiple times and so your pools turns to a swamp when it was just slightly off to start with. So they can put even more chemicals into the pool. Oh and NEVER try to contact them on saturdays. The service will ring for a few minutes and say they are unavailable to get to the phone and send you to voicemail. Service manager doesn’t work on saturdays. So they would never pick up. I learned that by going to the pool werx store. The ladies there are awesome, nice. But they could never get a service manager to actually show up or call me back. They speak to him. And they say he would call back and he never does.

So in short, way over priced. Worst customer service on the service side. They scam you by letting your pool go to crap while they never show up until they can make 60 + 300 in chemicals and multiple visits just to get it to the way it was the day you called them to set up service.

Also I love how they only say thanks to positive reviews but never address negative ones. Just that customer service team working wonders.
